newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China United places 150 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: China United places 150 mln new shares.

text.p: China United Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to place 150 million new shares, or 10.36 percent of the enlarged share capital, to private and institutional professional investors at HK$0.33 per share.
The placement price represents a 12 percent discount to the closing price of HK$0.375 on Wednesday.
The company said the net proceeds of HK$47.7 million would be used for general working capital.
Last month, the property investment and textiles group said it was considering the purchase of commercial property in Hong Kong.
